description:
Finding your next home in Spain just got a whole lot smarter ✨

By connecting Fotocasa with ChatGPT, you can explore thousands of property listings across Spain through a simple conversation. Browse homes with photos, detailed descriptions, and location insights, all while ChatGPT helps you narrow things down instantly based on what you’re looking for.

Just ask naturally, by voice or text:
- Show me flats with AC in Madrid under €1,200 with 2 bedrooms
- Find a family house in Seville with a garden and a pool
- Show me newly built flats in the Sant Andreu del Palomar area of Barcelona

The more details you share, the better ChatGPT can refine your search in real time.

Start exploring in a more intuitive way. Connect Fotocasa with ChatGPT today.

defaultPrompt: Busca pisos en venta en la Eixample
